title: The Dynamical Radius of Comparison for C*-Dynamical Systems
summary: We introduce a dynamical version $\operatorname{rc} (A, α)$ of the radius of comparison $\operatorname{rc} (A)$ of a unital C*-algebra, based on the dynamical Cuntz semigroup. We also give an intrinsic ordered semigroup definition, which agrees with $\operatorname{rc} (A, α)$ when $A$ is residually stably finite, and is lower semicontinuous for equivariant direct limits with injective unital maps.
